<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 56baf78e0c422b6555238043cc7d4c1a22db3568` → `packageMentionDocs`.

## Contract review

Local-runs: probe — `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, run in a throwaway worktree of the head (`/tmp/claude-0/seat3/wt-31152`, since removed), because the brief asks for the token readings from the repo's own ratchet (exit 0, 57 authored files inside their ceilings). Main-side token counts were taken by hand (`git show origin/main:<file> | wc -c`, release-stamp line removed on a SKILL.md, then ceil(bytes/4)).
Scope: the 20 files of `git diff origin/main...refs/seat3/pr-31152` (merge base `9f61e06e6` = `origin/main`, one commit `af6b6321c`): .changeset/skills-stale-teaching-after-ui-merge.md, content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx, packages/spec/scripts/build-skill-docs.ts, skills/README.md, skills/objectui/README.md, skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md, skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/datasources.md, indexing.md, lifecycle.md, relationships.md, skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json, hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json, skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md, rules/plugin-lifecycle.md, rules/service-registry.md, skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md, rules/filters.md, evals/filters-pagination-search.json, skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md. Cited code read at the head, where none of these code paths differ from `origin/main`: packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts (`sharingModel` enum L3745, `systemFields.tenant` L3309, archive refine L1067), packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts (`EMPTY_PREDICATE_DESCRIPTION` L1796, operator schemas L1829 / L1905, view lowering L2760-2763, `FILTER_OPERATORS` L3377), packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts (`isSystemObject` L280, `security-owd-unset` L843-877), packages/lint/src/validate-external-owner-sharing.ts (`READ_ONLY_EXTERNAL_WAY_OUT` L136, `externalOwnershipGap`), packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.ts (`INDEX_POSITION` L320, index judgment L551-568), packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (`TENANT_SCOPE_INDEX` L1692, `provisionTenantScopeIndex` L1694, `declaresTenantIndex` L1834), packages/create-objectstack/src/template-consistency.test.ts (`isMarkedInternal` L608), packages/spec/package.json (`files`), packages/skills/package.json and scripts/sync-catalog.mjs, .changeset/config.json (`fixed`), packages/metadata-core/src/audit-field-governance.ts, packages/spec/src/data/field-group-layout.ts, ui/scripts/check-doc-links.mjs (L732), scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, and the package.json versions of spec, runtime, cli, driver-memory, plugin-hono-server and skills.

### ① Derived judgments

Inputs: card #31114 (body; triage 6706611171; claim 6707729042), the PR body (identical to /mnt/project-files/card-31114/body-v1.md apart from the attribution comment), the commit, the net diff, the gate record gates-e6dcc651.txt (97 commands, all exit 0), and the seat's mid-flight rulings A, B, C and the data-hooks.md:961 deletion. Each taught fact was checked against code:

- **Item 1, objectui is not a separate repo.** TRUE.
  - No "separate repo" teaching remains in the touched files. No `objectstack-ai/objectui` link is left under `skills/` or `content/docs/ai/`. The two remaining `skills add objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills` lines are the `next` channel, which is correct.
  - The objectui README's two install lines copy the catalog README's pinned block exactly (`@objectstack/skills@$(…spec version)` plus `skills@1.7.2 experimental_sync --agent claude-code --copy -y`). `@objectstack/skills` ships the whole `skills/**` tree (`sync-catalog.mjs`), so objectui is in it.
  - Dropping "the CLI auto-detects your agent" is right: the taught command names the agent. Its two other facts have a home in the linked catalog README (skills land in `.claude/skills/`; "Name your own runtime after `--agent`").
  - The absolute catalog README URL is needed: `check-doc-links.mjs` L732 judges `skills/objectui` against `diskRoot: '../skills/objectui'`, so a relative `../README.md` leaves the bundle. The gate record shows the ui `scripts/` suite green after the change.
  - New links resolve. `tree/main/ui`, `tree/main/ui/packages/plugin-gantt` (which holds README.md) and `blob/main/skills/README.md` all exist. The link walk reads 243 links with 3 broken on main (exactly item 3's three) and 248 links with 0 broken at the head.
- **Item 2, the generator.** TRUE and behaviour-safe.
  - The predicate is "has `SKILL.md` and is not `metadata.internal`". `isMarkedInternal` is a byte-for-byte copy of the test's regex pair (frontmatter block, `^metadata:` line, indented `internal: true`). It admits `objectui`. No skill under `skills/` is internal today and there are no template directories, so the exclusion is latent but correct. `skills/README.md` (a file) fails `existsSync(<dir>/SKILL.md)` and stays out.
  - Plain scalar: `^description:\s*([^>\s].*)$` reads objectui's one-line description. A folded `>` or `>-` still takes the old branch.
  - Clause split: `\bUse (?:when|for)\b`, and `\bDo not use\b` made case-insensitive. The first match wins.
  - Byte-identical for the other ten: `build-skill-docs.ts --check` exits 0 at the head, so the head script reproduces the committed files. Those files differ from main only by the added objectui row and card and the count 10 → 11. So the ten existing entries render unchanged.
  - `DISPLAY` gains the objectui row. The lockstep check would refuse a missing one.
- **Item 3, anchors.** TRUE.
  - `plugin-development.md` L164 `## Complete Plugin Example` gives `#complete-plugin-example`. That is the AuditPlugin with `registerService` in `init()`, `kernel:ready` / `metadata:reloaded` hooks and `destroy()`, as the sentence says.
  - L280 `## Well-Known Plugin Names & Services` gives `#well-known-plugin-names--services` (ruling C). The table has 12 rows. "13 rows" is gone and no other "13 rows" remains under `skills/`.
  - data-hooks.md L961 is deleted (seat ruling). The data SKILL.md Quick Reference routes to that file.
- **Item 4, bootstrap.md pins.** TRUE. All five pins read `18.3.0`. `packages/spec`, `runtime`, `cli`, `drivers/driver-memory`, `plugins/plugin-hono-server` and `skills` are 18.3.0 on main, and so are all 11 SKILL.md `metadata.version` lines and the npm `latest` of the five packages.
- **Item 5, `sharingModel`.** TRUE.
  - The enum is `private | public_read | public_read_write | controlled_by_parent` (object.zod.ts L3745). Every value used is valid.
  - `security-owd-unset` is an error for a non-system object with no OWD (validate-security-posture.ts L843-877). `isSystemObject` is `isSystem === true` or a `sys_` name.
  - relationships.md: 9 of the 10 create calls now author one. `controlled_by_parent` sits on the two `master_detail` children (`invoice_line_item`, `invoice_line`), which matches the lint hint and the file's table.
  - lifecycle.md: 3 of 4. `sys_automation_run` is exempt by its `sys_` prefix. Confirmed.
  - datasources.md: `public_read` on `ext_customer`. The binding has no `external.writable: true` and no declared owner, so `hasUnprovableOwnerAnchor` holds and the lint prescribes `READ_ONLY_EXTERNAL_WAY_OUT`, which is `'public_read'`. Confirmed.
  - bootstrap.md L159 and plugin-development.md L33 mention `ObjectSchema.create({ … })` only in prose, so neither holds a complete example. The scaffolder's `note.object.ts` L54 authors `sharingModel: 'private'`. Confirmed.
  - The relationships.md ❌ `invoice_line_item` block (L378) is left without one. Acceptable: it is a labelled counter-example that no reader copies. See N2 on how the body names it.
- **Item 6, indexing.md.** TRUE on all three claims (ruling B: examples-objects.md is untouched, confirmed).
  - The tenant column is `organization_id` under `systemFields.tenant` (L3309: "Inject the organization_id column … the multi-tenant flag governs only its index").
  - "On a multi-tenant host the platform adds its single-column index": `provisionTenantScopeIndex` returns early unless `multiTenant`, then appends `{ fields: ['organization_id'] }`. `declaresTenantIndex` accepts only a one-column entry, so an author's composite that leads with `organization_id` does not suppress it. The sentence is exact.
  - "An index naming an undeclared `tenant_id` is refused": `validateObjectFieldRefs` judges each `indexes[].fields[]` name verbatim against authored plus injected columns, and pushes `object-field-ref-unknown` at `severity: 'error'`. It runs in the reference-integrity suite, which the runtime gate uses.
  - "A unique one says `unique: 'organization'` instead (above)" matches § unique scopes L57 ("do NOT list organization_id yourself").
- **Item 7.** No edit (ruling A). `project-setup.json` L20 lists `@object-ui/plugin-ai` under `must_not_contain`. The body records the file and line.
- **Item 8, `$empty`.** TRUE.
  - It is in `FILTER_OPERATORS` (L3377) and on both operator schemas, and it is the target of `is_empty` / `is_not_empty` (L2760-2763).
  - The taught semantics match `EMPTY_PREDICATE_DESCRIPTION`: null plus `''` on text-like types, null plus `[]` on multi-value types, null only on every other type, and `false` as the exact complement. A face that judges by declared type refuses it on an undeclared column such as `id`, so `$null` is used there.
  - The drivers (memory, mongodb, sql) carry `expandEmptyOperator`.
  - `$regex` / `$options` are not taught.
- **Item 9, upgrade wording.** TRUE. "`objectstack-pm-dispatch` is not in the 18 catalog, only an older install has it" holds: no such directory exists under `skills/`. The note sits in the prose, so the command stays copy-pasteable. See S2 for a gap in the same roster.
- **Deletions paying the budget.** Each cut fact checked for a surviving home:
  - objectui README: the skills.sh badge is a pointer only. The auto-detect sentence is covered above.
  - page-builder.md: a shorter URL only. No fact cut.
  - data-hooks.md: a dead link only. Its home is the file itself.
  - relationships.md `post_tag` block: "an explicit junction object with two required lookups" lives in § Many-to-Many: Junction Object (`project_assignment`, two `lookup`s with `required: true`, plus the unique pair index). The link `#many-to-many-junction-object` resolves.
  - relationships.md `// Contact can exist without account`: `required: false` itself, the `// Child: Contact (independent lifecycle)` comment, and the table row "lookup | Independent | Optional by default".
  - lifecycle.md intro "the save notice a hook hands the saver": § Save Notice (L143) and the data SKILL.md Quick Reference row L45.
  - lifecycle.md `// must: after === maxAge`: **no explicit home.** See S1.
  - datasources.md ", not only on a federated object": the same bullet's "on ANY object" and "everywhere".
  - filters.md "`$null: false` is `IS NOT NULL`": the Operator Reference row (`IS NULL` / `IS NOT NULL`) and the SKILL.md Null table. Adequate.
  - filters.md date comment: its first half did not match the code, and its second half is the section's lead sentence.
- **Evals.** All three JSON files parse. The ids run 1-9, 1-10 and 1-7 with no gaps.
  - Data case 8: TRUE. `deleteBehavior` on `master_detail` is `cascade` or `restrict` only, so `must_not_contain: set_null` is consistent.
  - Data case 9: TRUE (see item 6). See N1.
  - Data hooks case 10: TRUE. It matches the read-only external prescription.
  - Query case 7: TRUE. `$null: true` misses `''` on a textarea, and `$empty: true` catches it. See N1.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch` is right. The change is skill prose, eval fixtures and the catalog README, and `@objectstack/skills` ships all three (the whole `skills/**` tree).

No `'@objectstack/spec': patch` is owed for the generator. The card asked for one only "if the generator ships in a published package". It does not: `packages/spec/package.json` `files` is `dist, json-schema, liveness, prompts, llms.txt, README.md, src/**/*.zod.ts, CHANGELOG.md, api-surface, spec-changes.json, protocol-upgrade-guide.md`, and `scripts/` is not in it. Its two outputs ship in `@objectstack/skills` (skills/README.md) or nowhere (content/docs). Also, spec and skills sit in one `fixed` group in .changeset/config.json, so the version moves together either way. The body states this reasoning.

`Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are right: no schema, contract or metadata meaning moves. Both lines are line-initial in the changeset and in the PR body.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Claim.** All 20 paths are inside claim 6707729042: item 1's three files, item 2's generator and its two regenerated outputs, item 3's three files, item 4's file, item 5's three edited files, item 6's indexing.md, item 8's two files, item 9's file, eval JSONs of the touched data and query skills, and one changeset. Untouched, as ruled: examples-objects.md (B), project-setup.json (A), and plugin-development.md (no complete example). Same-file payment cuts sit outside "the complete object examples" in relationships.md, lifecycle.md, datasources.md and filters.md. The ratchet discipline requires that payment and the body names each cut. Not a breach.
- **Ratchet script.** Unchanged against `origin/main`. No ceiling moved, so standing ruling 6513306068 was not used.
- **Tier.** `check-governed-merges --pr 31152`: GOVERNED, Tier H, `skills/**` ×17. Off the register: the changeset, skills-reference.mdx and build-skill-docs.ts. Size +171 / −44 (215 lines), under 3000. Landing needs the maintainer's merge or an APPROVED review from `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, and the body says so. The PR is a draft with `mergeable_state` blocked. Labels: documentation, size/m, tooling.
- **PR body.** It has `Fixes #31114` and a model-tier waiver that names no model ("the project's default model"). No model identifier appears in the body, title, diff or commit. The commit trailer is model-free.
- **Other sites outside the claim, confirmed for filing.** The thread's list is short by three:
  - `content/docs/releases/v12.mdx` L204 and `v14.mdx` L298 link the archived objectui CHANGELOG. Confirmed.
  - `content/docs/releases/v13.mdx` L188 has the same link. The thread missed it.
  - `content/docs/releases/index.mdx` L8 says, in the present tense, that the Console UI is "built from the objectui repository", and L40 links the archived objectui CHANGELOG. This is the overview page, not a per-release note. Feature PRs edit it (for example #27912), so item 1's correction can reach it without hand-editing a release note. Worth filing.
  - `docs/adr/0072-…md` L5 links an ADR in the objectui repo. It is historical and correct as it is.

### ④ Design judgment

- **One home per rule.** Held for the new teaching. `$empty` has one row in each of the query surfaces, which mirrors `$null`. The tenant-column paragraph points at § unique scopes instead of restating it.
- **Token budget.** No ceiling was raised and the script exits 0. All readings match the PR body and the brief.

| File | main | head | ceiling |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| objectui/README.md | 728 | 733 | 735 |
| objectui/guides/page-builder.md | 3410 | 3409 | 3411 |
| objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md | 10011 | 9987 | 10011 |
| objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md | 3870 | 3873 | 3873 |
| objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md | 1590 | 1588 | 1590 |
| objectstack-data/rules/datasources.md | 908 | 908 | 911 |
| objectstack-data/rules/indexing.md | 2200 | 2284 | 3241 |
| objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md | 1350 | 1350 | 1351 |
| objectstack-platform/rules/plugin-lifecycle.md | 1775 | 1787 | 2408 |
| objectstack-platform/rules/service-registry.md | 1754 | 1764 | 2331 |
| objectstack-query/SKILL.md | 4234 | 4329 | 5547 |
| objectstack-query/rules/filters.md | 2482 | 2477 | 2482 |
| objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md | 6160 | 6180 | 6188 |

  There is no separate line-budget gate on `skills/**`. The two SKILL.md files touched are 413 and 483 lines.

- **should-fix S1, lifecycle.md lost the explicit archive rule.** The cut `// must: after === maxAge` was the page's only statement that `archive.after` must equal `retention.maxAge`. object.zod.ts L1067 refuses any mismatch. The named home, "❌ Archive window detached from the hot window", shows one refused pair (30d against 90d) but never says "equal", so a reader may think a longer `after` is fine. Fix it inside the budget: reword that ❌ comment to `// ❌ archive.after must equal retention.maxAge`, which is about 2 bytes shorter than the current comment. The lane rule is that a cut with no surviving home drops a rule. This is not blocking only because the parse refusal names the rule.
- **should-fix S2, the upgrade roster omits `objectui`.** Until this PR, the objectui README taught `npx skills add objectstack-ai/objectui`. Such an install has a `sourceType: github` lock entry, so `experimental_sync` skips it, exactly as the paragraph explains for the `objectstack-*` names. The agent then keeps the 17.x objectui text, and the `skills remove` roster does not list it. Adding `objectui` to the roster costs about 3 tokens of the 8 left, and "a missing name is skipped" makes it safe. Fold it in, or file it with item 1's follow-up.
- **should-fix S3, the body overstates how growth was paid.** The 维护者速读 section says all growth is paid by same-file deletions. Seven files grow into existing headroom: objectui README +5, relationships +3, indexing +84, plugin-lifecycle +12, service-registry +10, query SKILL.md +95 and upgrade SKILL.md +20. The English table marks five of them "inside headroom" but not the README and relationships rows. The script's discipline says new text is paid by same-file deletion, and the script itself accepts landing inside a ceiling. Correct the sentence and label the two rows.
- **nit N1, eval assertions punish a careful answer.** Data case 9's `must_not_contain: tenant_id` fails an answer that warns "not `tenant_id`", and the case's own `expected_output` says exactly that. Query case 7's `$regex` / `$options` exclusions have the same shape. Accept the risk, or assert on `fields: ['tenant_id'` instead.
- **nit N2, the body names the ❌ block a "fragment that shows one key".** It is a complete create call. The real reason to leave it is that it is labelled ❌ and never copied. Reword it in the body only.
- **nit N3, generator edge cases.** The plain-scalar branch would read a `|` block indicator or a quoted scalar verbatim. No skill uses either today. Separately, the generated intro still says "one per authoring domain", and `ui` now has two skills.
- **nit N4, optional ceiling drops.** data-hooks.md (−24), filters.md (−5), lifecycle.md (−2) and page-builder.md (−1) shrank. The script encourages lowering their ceilings. If S1 is taken, leave lifecycle.md's ceiling where it is.
- **Check-runs on this head**, read 2026-11-07T14:58Z: 62 runs, 24 success, 7 skipped, 31 in progress, 0 failed.

Verdict: PASS
